title: Cross-platform CASA common-beam quantity conversion
source: casacore Quantum::getValue divides by destination/source unit factors; CasaImageBeamSet constructs common ellipses in arcseconds.
platforms: Linux x86_64 official manylinux_2_28 CASA wheel in a disposable container

law_cases.115: Same CASA reference on both platforms; changing arcsecond intermediate to radians fails on both.
law_cases.156: Same CASA reference on both platforms; replacing quantity division with reciprocal multiplication fails on both.
law_cases.409: CASA takes different floating-point enclosure paths across platforms; corrected native matches each platform.

prior_ci: At 075cfb1e619bceb5903f336b6b483841fcb0cc09 Linux reported three common-beam reference failures. Original case 53 CASA differs between macOS and Linux; native matched Linux. Two-beam native differed by one 0.1% enlargement until the division-order fix.
negative_hypothesis: Keeping intermediate arcsecond axes separately did not repair case 156.
validation: Both new or replacement laws passed and failed their targeted mutations on both platforms; source was restored exactly. Linux Rust tests were compiled with rustc --test; macOS used cargo test.
